title: Find the deployment boundary before hardware selection
description: Combine workload activity, execution path, and a disturbance. The model exposes routing pressure, latency, relative energy, quality, and the fallback decision.

workloads.label: Always-on keyword stream
workloads.detail: Continuous audio with brief decision-relevant segments.

workloads.label: Event-camera gesture
workloads.detail: Asynchronous contrast events with bursty hand motion.

workloads.label: Dense visual inspection
workloads.detail: Fine texture across most pixels makes the signal much less sparse.

architectures.label: End-to-end event path
architectures.detail: Event sensor, spiking model, and on-device readout preserve sparsity.

architectures.label: Dense-to-spike adapter
architectures.detail: A frame or tensor is encoded into spikes before neuromorphic execution.

architectures.label: Hybrid event front end
architectures.detail: Sparse temporal features run first; a dense back end handles ambiguous cases.

architectures.label: Conventional dense baseline
architectures.detail: A CPU, GPU, or dense accelerator evaluates the full representation.

disturbances.label: Nominal signal
disturbances.detail: The input resembles the measured qualification set.

disturbances.label: Sensor noise burst
disturbances.detail: Background changes multiply ingress events and pressure the router.

disturbances.label: Event loss or mapping gap
disturbances.detail: Dropped packets or unsupported neuron behavior reduce task fidelity.
